name: System overview
author: WinDock
description: CPU, memory, GPU, disk and network at a glance: one row on a dock, a list with sparklines on the desktop.

settings.label: CPU
settings.description: Shows how busy the processor is. On by default.

settings.label: Memory
settings.description: Shows how much memory is in use. On by default.

settings.label: GPU
settings.description: Shows how busy the graphics card is. On by default.

settings.label: Disk
settings.description: Shows how busy the disks are. On by default.

settings.label: Network
settings.description: Shows the network's download and upload speed. On by default.

settings.label: Layout
settings.description: One row of cells, or a list with a line per metric. Automatic: one row on a top or bottom dock, a list on a left or right dock and on the desktop. Default: automatic.

choices.label: Automatic (a dock: one row; the desktop: a list)

settings.label: Style
settings.description: Bars or sparklines (small graphs over time). Automatic: bars in one row, sparklines in a list. Default: automatic.

choices.label: Automatic (one row: bars; a list: sparklines)

settings.label: Show the values
settings.description: Writes each metric's current value. On by default.

settings.label: Sparkline history
settings.description: How much time the sparklines cover. Default: 60.

settings.label: Update every
settings.description: How often the values are read. Default: 1000 (once a second).

settings.label: Warning from
settings.description: CPU, memory, GPU and disk (percent); 0: off.

settings.label: Warning colour
settings.description: The colour a metric turns once it reaches Warning from. Default: amber.

settings.label: Critical from
settings.description: From this level a metric turns the critical colour (CPU, memory, GPU and disk); 0: off. Default: 90.

settings.label: Critical colour
settings.description: The colour a metric turns once it reaches Critical from. Default: red.

settings.label: Background
settings.description: What is drawn behind the widget: nothing, a dark panel, or the theme's label panel. Default: none.

settings.label: Width of a row's cell on a top or bottom dock
settings.description: How wide each metric's cell is when the widget is one row on a top or bottom dock. Default: 44.
